summary: Completed backend and frontend regression testing for dashboard cache-busting, quick-add navigation, order creation persistence, notifications, mobile navigation, and overflow.
action_items: Consider replacing the DOM event listener for quick-add with a React onClick handler for simpler maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is approaching a large monolithic component; extracting Shell, Dashboard, and TablePage would improve maintainability, but no blocking defect was found.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed API records and one UI order named UI Iteration 3 Order for persistence validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard request includes fresh timestamp and no-cache header; quick-add navigates to /products; order creation appears after reload; notifications, mobile menu, and overflow passed.
rca of the issue: Iteration 2 issues are resolved: dashboard now requests a cache-busted endpoint, quick-add has navigation behavior, and the orders modal posts to /api/orders. The browser confirmed the newly created order is rendered after reload. The automation’s final error scan had a malformed JavaScript selector string, so that scan itself was not executed; all application flow assertions before it passed.
